entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: % 08.05.2023 [ The proceeding has been conducted through Hybrid mode ]

1. This an appeal filed under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1954 challenging the impugned judgment dated 18.03.2023 passed by the learned Reference Court in LAC No. 18/21 titled as "Ishwar Singh & Ors. vs. Union of India & Anr." seeking further enhancement in the compensation of amount and modification to that extent of the impugned judgment in respect of land acquired of Village Barwala vide Award No.12/2005-06.

sentences.text: 2. Mr. Verma, learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits that the issues in the present appeal already pending adjudication in another similar appeal in LA.
APP.138/2018 titled as "Chander Bhan vs. Union of India & Ors.", which had been admitted by this Court on 13.08.2018 and is now listed for adjudication in the category of regular matters.
